title: Test a coordination request against member loss
description: Choose a voting topology, remove voters, and change the read or write contract. The model separates cluster quorum from endpoint reachability and makes the stale-read trade-off explicit.

topologies.label: 3 voting members
topologies.detail: Majority is 2. The cluster tolerates one unavailable voter.

topologies.label: 5 voting members
topologies.detail: Majority is 3. Two voter failures are tolerated, but every write has more peers to coordinate.

topologies.label: 3 voters + 1 learner
topologies.detail: The learner catches up without changing quorum. Promote it only after it is ready and the change is reviewed.

requests.label: Write or transaction
requests.detail: Commit an ordered mutation through the Raft leader and a voting majority.
requests.path: client endpoint -> leader -> voter majority -> durable commit

requests.label: Linearizable read
requests.detail: Return the latest value in the global order; this depends on a live consensus path.
requests.path: client endpoint -> live consensus path -> current committed revision

requests.label: Serializable read
requests.detail: Serve local member state without quorum coordination; lower latency can include stale data.
requests.path: client endpoint -> local applied state, which may trail quorum

endpoints.label: Reachable leader
endpoints.detail: The client reaches the current leader and the leader can reach available voters.

endpoints.label: Reachable follower
endpoints.detail: The endpoint can reach the leader and voting majority; the client does not need to discover the leader itself.

endpoints.label: Partitioned follower
endpoints.detail: The client can reach this member, but the member cannot reach the cluster consensus path.
